core_pain: Months (sometimes years) of silence, and it still feels unfinished. She deleted the messages but replays the conversation anyway; she dreams about him and wakes up annoyed at herself; every new person gets measured against him; and underneath it all is the question nobody answers: "What am I actually still holding onto?" The humiliation is private: she is "over it" out loud and not at all at 2 a.m. What she tried (blocking, therapy talk, "just move on", dating apps, manifesting content) treats the thought as the enemy; none of it names what the thought is protecting. Men's branch is the same loop with a different mask: he "doesn't think about her" except when he does, and he has nobody he'd say it to.
buying_agenda: She is not buying "tarot". She is buying a private, non-judging place to finally put words on the thing she can't say to friends (who are tired of hearing it) or to a therapist (too expensive/too formal/too slow), at 2 a.m., on her phone, without anyone knowing. Agenda in order: (1) be understood without explaining herself, (2) get a name for what she is holding onto (the relief of "oh, that's what it is"), (3) feel permission to let go without it meaning she didn't matter, (4) have somewhere to go the next time the thought comes back. The subscription sells on #4: "ask again every time the thought comes back" is the real product, the reading is the door. Price objection is weak at $9.99 (cost of two coffees vs. a $120 therapy hour or a $40 psychic call); the real objection is "is this just generic stuff I could read for free?" which the chat quiz + reaction + preview must answer before the paywall.
benchmark: Direct competitors for this pain on Facebook mobile: (a) psychic-hotline / "will he come back" chat apps and Keen/Kasamba style per-minute readers, which sell outcome promises (he's coming back, he misses you) and are expensive and legally/ethically fragile; (b) generic tarot apps (Labyrinthos, Golden Thread) that sell features and card knowledge, not a pain; (c) twin-flame / cord-cutting meditation content on TikTok/YouTube that sells the "energetic cord" as literal fact and is free; (d) breakup-recovery coaching and "get your ex back" ebooks ($27-97) that sell a result. Gap AstroTarot occupies: a personalized written reading that names the attachment without promising the ex, with a built-in next step (guided Cord Cutting Ritual as symbolic release) and a 24/7 guide, at a price below one psychic call. The honest-claims posture ("cards interpret, never predict your ex") is itself a differentiator against (a) and (c), and the 7-day guarantee beats per-minute billing. Permitted proof to deploy: 120,000+ readings delivered, 4.9 rating. Nothing else.
validation_verdict: ADVANCE. Pain is urgent (not latent): it interrupts sleep and dating, and the audience already pays for it (psychics, readers, coaching). Demand evidence is structural rather than invented: the existing funnel engine, the /rituals/cord-cutting product, and the ex segment already live at /quiz/ex. Differentiation is real (personalized written reading + honest interpretive frame + ritual next step + unlimited re-asking) and deliverable today. Deductions: (1) the big idea "why can't you stop thinking about them" is crowded by free TikTok content and must win on intimacy of the chat, not on the question itself; (2) the claims constraint forbids the outcome promise competitors use, so CTR will depend on the hook naming the private experience precisely; (3) subscription is an odd SLO shape (recurring, not one-shot), so the 7-day guarantee and the "ask again" framing must carry the low-friction feel. Kill conditions: if the preview ("Your Connection") doesn't feel specific to her answers, conversion dies at the paywall regardless of hook.
slo: Name: "Your Connection" reading (entry experience inside the Unlimited subscription). Promise: After your reading, you'll have a clear name for what you're still holding onto about {him}, and a symbolic way to set it down, even if you've already "done everything" to move on. Delivery: chat with Master Aura (gender question + 6-8 short questions with honest reactions), 3 transition messages, 4 Egyptian major-arcana cards with interpretation + pattern line, then the free preview with 5 real fields (Emotional attachment / Unfinished feelings / Recurring thoughts / What you're holding onto / What may need to be released, all keyed to {pattern}), then layered open loop to the full reading. Consumption time: under 10 minutes on mobile. Proof allowed: 120,000+ readings delivered, 4.9 rating, 7-day real guarantee. Price: $9.99/month anchor, $39.99/6 months, $59.99/year; justification: less than one psychic call, and the thought doesn't come back once, so the reading can't be a one-time thing either. Connection to the system: the reading names the attachment; the natural next step is the guided Cord Cutting Ritual (/rituals/cord-cutting, symbolic release, included), then Dreams (she dreams of him) and Past Lives as further experiences; Spiritual Guide 24/7 is the "2 a.m." retention mechanism. Minimal funnel: hook -> chat quiz -> cards -> preview -> LP (08-lp-copywriter) -> subscription; post-purchase upsell already exists: Draw My Soulmate portrait $24.99 (shifts the gaze from him to what's next; never framed as a prediction). First sales without paid traffic: organic Reels of a blurred chat excerpt ("the question she couldn't answer"), Facebook group threads on breakup recovery, email re-engagement of existing readers.
angles: ACUTE PAIN — "You deleted the messages. So why are you still answering them in your head?" (test var: "It's been months. Why does it still feel unfinished?") — use as FB primary text line 1 / hook screen
IDENTITY / SELF-BETRAYAL — "You're fine. You said it out loud today. Then it was 2 a.m." (test var: "Over it by day. Not at 2 a.m.") — use for retargeting and Stories

COUNTER-INTUITIVE — "The thought isn't about them. It's about something you haven't put down yet." (test var: "You're not missing him. You're holding something.") — use as hook line + first Aura message

LIMITING BELIEF — "Nobody is still thinking about someone this long by accident." (test var: "You don't keep dreaming about someone for no reason.") — use where the audience is the dreams/comparison sub-pain

COMMON ENEMY (the advice) — "'Just move on' has never once worked on a thought that shows up uninvited." (test var: "Block, delete, move on. You did all three. Still here.") — use for audiences saturated by breakup-coaching ads
mechanism: A chat with Master Aura that asks only what she already knows (how long it's been, who left, what still shows up: dreams, comparisons, replayed conversations, what she'd say if she could), gives an honest micro-reflection after every answer, then draws 4 Egyptian major-arcana cards and reads them against her pattern. The cards interpret ("this card often marks a door that was never properly closed"), never predict or speak for him. Output: a written, personal "Your Connection" reading plus the guided Cord Cutting Ritual as symbolic release. No birth chart, no energetic claims, no third-party facts; the only "data" is her own answers and the cards.
offer_path: Hook (Facebook mobile) -> /quiz/ex chat: gender question first (woman/man, pattern none, own reaction each) -> woman branch covers both "I left" and "I was left" via options; man branch = his ex -> 6-8 questions with honest reactions -> 3 transition messages -> 4 cards -> free preview \"Your Connection\" (5 fields using {pattern}) -> layered open loop -> LP: sub <=2 lines, 3 connections, 5 criteria, authority = 120,000+ readings / 4.9 only, priceLine with 3 cycles ($9.99/mo, $39.99/6mo, $59.99/yr), 7-day guarantee, 4 FAQs with the skeptic objection (\"isn't this generic?\") answered honestly -> Unlimited subscription -> inside product: full reading, then Cord Cutting Ritual (/rituals/cord-cutting, symbolic release), Dreams, Spiritual Guide 24/7 for every time the thought returns -> post-purchase upsell Draw My Soulmate $24.99.
analytics_success: Dimension variant = pain_ex. Primary: paid-subscription conversion rate from quiz start (compare against the existing /quiz/ex baseline and the intimacy/body/money segments). Funnel steps to watch: hook CTR (FB) -> gender answered -> quiz completion rate (target: no step drops more than the prior one; a cliff at any reaction question means that reaction is dishonest or generic) -> preview viewed -> LP CTA click -> payment form appeared (already instrumented) -> purchase -> 7-day refund rate (the honesty check: high refunds mean the preview over-promised) -> day-7 retention: did she open the Cord Cutting Ritual or ask Aura again (the \"ask again\" promise must show up as usage, or the subscription framing is wrong). Secondary: woman vs man branch conversion, \"I left\" vs \"I was left\" conversion, Draw My Soulmate take rate. Decision rule: keep the chosen hook if CTR and quiz-completion beat the current ex funnel; otherwise swap to angle 1 (acute pain) before touching the quiz.
